_meta.purpose: Structured therioform dataset for rippers-compendium. Feeds Artificer's per-guise therioform picker on the play surface. Same spirit/shape as spells-source.json (a data table the snapshot-driven build can consume).
_meta.generated_by: Compiler (hive), 2026-09-04, from lodge-docs/CLASSREF-mutant.md (print-verified vs Techno Fantasy Atlas pp.156-157 per Coroner). Local only, not published.

granting_skill.learn_rule: Each Skill Level teaches ONE therioform (one learned per level, up to 6). Verified in snapshot: mutant/theriomorphosis max_sl 6.
granting_skill.manifest_rule: Action + cost to manifest UP TO TWO therioforms at once; they last the scene and end if you die, fall unconscious, Guard, or use the Skill again; you may drop them voluntarily on your turn; 10 MP at scene's end carries them into the next.
granting_skill.cost_variant: ✎ Adopted VARIANT (RULE-adopted-variants §2, permanent choice at Skill-take): flat 20 HP to manifest up to two immediately, then a free attack with High Roll treated as 0 — replaces the printed 'a third of current HP' + wait. Greater Theriomorphosis under the variant: up to THREE forms, free attack uses full High Roll.
granting_skill.source_lines: CLASSREF-mutant.md L87 (skill), L54-64 (variant + Greater), L28 (SL totals)

notes: Class is INNATE-ONLY (mutant.is_innate_only = true): therioforms are the Mutant's own flesh, live only while unmasked — they cannot be hung in a Guise cabinet (CLASSREF-mutant.md L24, L40-48). The 'per-guise therioform picker' therefore surfaces on the Mutant's own (unmasked/innate) form, not a worn Guise.

Effect text is verbatim-faithful to the CLASSREF table's own compressed wording (which the file states is 'this table's' wording, mechanics from Atlas pp.156-157); the full printed text lives in the Atlas. Genoclepsis species suggestions kept as the parenthetical the table prints.

Pterotheria carries a house ✎ flight-monopoly note (CLASSREF-mutant.md L66-71, L106): under the variant it costs 20 HP, lasts the scene, ends on Guard; the only unrestricted flight route in the campaign.

COUNT = 12 canonical (corrected 2026-09-04, god dispatch f361a6). Coroner re-audited the printed Techno Fantasy Atlas pp.156-157 directly and confirmed TWELVE, with COMPENDIUM-player-reference.md's list matching print word-for-word. Tachytheria + Toxicophora were promoted from the old excluded{} block into therioforms[] and their effect text pulled from the print-verified COMPENDIUM source (L194-199). The first 10 kept as built (correct).

SOURCE CORRECTION (finding): the original build used CLASSREF-mutant.md, which lists only 10 therioforms (table L96-107) and omits Tachytheria + Toxicophora — despite its own '✅ BUILT FROM PRINT — all ten therioforms check out' banner (CLASSREF-mutant.md L12-14). That banner is FALSE by count (10 vs the printed 12). CLASSREF-mutant.md is a drifted/incomplete source for the therioform list; COMPENDIUM-player-reference.md L166-199 is the print-accurate one — though note its own label reads '*The ten therioforms:*' (L166) while listing 12 (a stale label). Flagged for Austin/Coroner to reconcile the CLASSREF banner + the COMPENDIUM label.

therioforms.name: Amphibia
therioforms.effect: Breathe underwater, see in dim light; your HP recovery gains +5 and may clear one status effect.

therioforms.name: Arpaktida
therioforms.effect: Insight one die size up (max d12); the first time each turn you damage creatures, any in Crisis take 5 extra.

therioforms.name: Dynamotheria
therioforms.effect: Might one die size up (max d12); Might-inclusive Clock Checks move one extra section.

therioforms.name: Electrophora
therioforms.effect: Your attack/spell damage may become bolt; an enemy losing 20+ HP to a bolt unarmed strike suffers slow.

therioforms.name: Neurophagoida
therioforms.effect: Biophagy also restores (4 + Theriomorphosis SL) Mind Points.

therioforms.name: Placophora
therioforms.effect: Defense may read (13 + half Theriomorphosis SL), if better.

therioforms.name: Pneumophora
therioforms.effect: Your attack/spell damage may become air; the 20+ HP unarmed rider inflicts weak.

therioforms.name: Pterotheria
therioforms.effect: You fly — melee reaches the flying, melee cannot reach you unless the attacker can. Void in cramped spaces; suffering air, bolt or ice damage in a conflict grounds you until your next turn.
therioforms.house_note: ✎ The flight monopoly: under the adopted variant it costs 20 HP, lasts the scene, ends if you Guard; the only unrestricted route to flying in the campaign (CLASSREF-mutant.md L66-71).

therioforms.name: Pyrophora
therioforms.effect: Your attack/spell damage may become fire; the 20+ HP unarmed rider inflicts dazed.

therioforms.name: Tachytheria
therioforms.effect: You treat your Dexterity attribute as one die size higher (maximum d12); when you succeed on a Check that includes Dexterity to advance or turn back a Clock, fill or erase 1 additional section.
therioforms.source_line: COMPENDIUM-player-reference.md L194-196 (print-verified vs Techno Fantasy Atlas pp.156-157, Coroner)

therioforms.name: Toxicophora
therioforms.effect: You may make all damage you deal poison damage; while your unarmed strikes deal poison damage, any enemy that loses 20 or more Hit Points to one of them also suffers poisoned.
therioforms.source_line: COMPENDIUM-player-reference.md L197-199 (print-verified vs Techno Fantasy Atlas pp.156-157, Coroner)
